notes: The catalogue defines a baseline, not a promise every field exists on every host.
source_field identifies either a verified literal field or a deliberately named versioned adapter; it is not universally a JSONPath.
Vendor attributes, full inventory, evidence and optional provider fields require separate versioned extensions.
Server semantic validation must enforce kind/unit/value_type/scope and bounded attributes in addition to JSON Schema.
Do not emit unavailable fields as zero; preserve capability separately from per-attempt errors.

Metric identities and source semantics are unchanged in heartbeat v2.0. Repeated collection IDs are not new samples. Agent transport health is represented by envelope metadata, not additional disk metrics.
